name: Purified PHBV-39, hot-pressed cut specimens

names.ja: 精製PHBV-39、熱プレス切断試験片

product_form.text: Hot-pressed discs cut into specimens 10 mm × 2.5 mm × 0.5 mm

processing.text: PHBV-rich biomass lyophilized and acetone washed; CHCl3 Soxhlet extraction followed by cold petroleum-ether and methanol precipitation/purification and vacuum drying; 0.3 g disc samples hot-pressed at 180 °C
processing.notes: Purified is a source processing designation, not a claim of 100% purity.

temper_or_heat_treatment.notes: Not reported for this selected source-qualified result.

conditioning.text: Vacuum dried at 60 °C overnight before hot pressing
conditioning.notes: Post-molding conditioning time and relative humidity are not specified.

composition_or_purity.text: Table 1 purified PHBV-39: purity 88.5 ± 4.7%; 3HV molar fraction 0.21 ± 0.01 by GC-MS
composition_or_purity.notes: The meaning of these composition ± tokens is not defined by the inspected Table 1; do not transfer the mechanical Table 9 SD footnote. The 1H-NMR comparison 0.19 ± 0.00 is attributed to reference [6], not used as the selected composition assay here. Composition context does not add a reference-property record.

reinforcement.notes: Not reported for this selected source-qualified result.

porosity.notes: Not reported for this selected source-qualified result.

orientation.notes: Not reported for this selected source-qualified result.

source_scope: PHBV-39 isolated from mixed microbial consortia fed fermented dairy manure in the study. 39 denotes operational day, not 39% HV, a grade, a specimen count or a distinct polymer family. Other operational days are not additional material identities in this batch. This supplement also records source-labelled flexural strength; property-specific method/statistics and unknown extraction criterion remain separate.
